item.title: Week 10: Texans at Browns
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: HOU -4.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model CLE 44% vs. market 36% | On paper Houston has the edge (Houston's defense ranks 14th in QB hit + sack rate, 16% generated). Under center, C.J. Stroud ranks 6th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Deshaun Watson ranks 24th; x-factor: Denzel Boston gets 22% of Cleveland's targets and 40% of its air yards, and Houston's pass defense ranks 18th. The model favors Houston at 56%, mostly on starting QB (2.6 pts) and passing matchup (2.4 pts).
